profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at Intuitive Machines

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
SEADS (Smart Energy Analytic Disaggregation System) performs energy monitoring of home appliances, based on intelligent IoT (Internet of Things) technology. This project utilizes a Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring (NILM) system to monitor consumers’ energy usage. SEADS aims to provide power outage detection/notification, monitor voltage/power in real-time, and measure harmonics on the voltage or current. Using NILM, users will be able to identify how much power each load is consuming and act accordingly.

My responsibilities on this project include the following: 
 - Determining the phase error introduced by the instrument transformers used to step-down the SEADS device’s input voltage.
 - Reviewing firmware for the SEADS device
 - Researching the possibility of utilizing synchrophasors to determine which phase of the 3-phase power system the unit is connected to. This feature will possibly be incorporated into the next stage of the SEADS project.
